name: DeepInfra
short: Serverless inference cloud with per-token pricing across open models — no long-term contracts or upfront costs.

plans.name: Unauthenticated Free Testing
plans.notes: Allows querying supported open models without an API key or credit card via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, rate-limited strictly by IP address for quick local prototyping.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go (text)
plans.notes: e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Flash $0.09/$0.18 per 1M; Kimi K3 $2.85/$14.25; Nemotron 3.5 Lightning $0.06/$0.16.

plans.name: GPU instances
plans.notes: Dedicated deployments bill by the hour; serverless text models use the per-token rates above.
